items.detail_en: Two questions: 1) Why did you choose to become a principal? What is your philosophy of education? 2) Why do international connections and English learning matter so much for Tianjhong students?
items.detail_zh: 兩個問題：一、校長為何擔任校長，教育理念為何？二、為何國際連結與英語教育對田中高中學生很重要？
items.note_en: For the Voices in Education series.
items.note_zh: 收錄於「教育之聲」專訪系列。

items.class: Junior High Class 807 國中部 807 班
items.detail_en: In the Class 807 classroom. Dom shares her own life journey to help students build a global mindset and think about their future.
items.detail_zh: 在 807 教室。以 Dom 自己的經歷，引導學生建立國際觀、思考自己的未來。

items.detail_en: 15 minutes to move to the senior high session.
items.detail_zh: 15 分鐘，移動到高中部的場地。

items.class: Senior High Classes 203 & 103 高中部 203、103 班
items.detail_en: Both classes together, probably in a special classroom (room to be confirmed). The two classes' English teachers will be there.
items.detail_zh: 兩班合班，擬借用專科教室（教室待確認）。兩班英文老師隨班陪伴。

footnote_en: Arranged by Julie Lien (連淑苓). The morning ends around 11:00 a.m. In the afternoon, Dom is at Huatan Junior High. The school has also asked My Culture Connect to make an English video promoting Tianjhong Senior High.
footnote_zh: 連淑苓老師安排。上午約 11:00 結束，下午 Dom 在花壇國中。學校另請人師教育協會協助製作推廣田中高中的英語影片。
